claim: Spa Lady, 55 Lafayette Rd, Fords — listed as an active fitness center (source: us-business.info)
problem: A different business, Mauka Fitness, publishes that exact address (55 Lafayette Rd, Fords, NJ 08863) on its own site. 'Spa Lady' is also a multi-location NJ women's fitness brand, i.e. a chain, which is an excluded type. Inference (not stated by any source): the Fords club has closed or been rebranded. Either way the entry is not a live, independent local business.
fix: Remove the Spa Lady entry; if the location still trades, list Mauka Fitness after verifying ownership.

claim: Home Well Senior Care, 386 New Brunswick Ave, Fords, (732) 738-0333 — home care agency
problem: 'HomeWell Care Services' is a franchise system (HomeWell Franchising LLC files a public FDD) and its own locations pages do not show a Fords/Woodbridge office; NJ operations are listed out of Hackensack/Brick. The Fords address appears only in legacy aggregator data. Inference: stale listing of a franchise that is no longer at that address. Franchises are an excluded type.
fix: Drop, or verify directly that an independently owned HomeWell agency still operates at 386 New Brunswick Ave before any outreach.

claim: Hugh O. Habas, DDS, 565 New Brunswick Ave, Fords, (732) 738-5878 — separate dental practice
problem: The office's own website (fordsdental.com) states the Fords practice is Craig S. Weinstein, DMD's, and that it 'started with Dr. Weinstein's father-in-law 35 years ago, Dr. Hugh Habas'. Habas shares the exact address and phone with the Weinstein entry in this list, so it is a predecessor/legacy listing, not a separate active business.
fix: Delete the Habas entry and keep Craig S. Weinstein, DMD (565 New Brunswick Ave, 732-738-5878).

claim: Opticare Physical Therapy, 155 New Brunswick Ave, Hopelawn, (732) 826-1732

Healthgrades lists Mina Massak / Opticare Physical Therapy at the same address with phone (732) 641-3620, not the listed 826-1732. Inference: Opticare rebranded to Logos PT; the listed name and phone are outdated, so the record is misidentified.
fix: Replace with Logos Physical Therapy, 155 New Brunswick Ave, (732) 641-3620, noting Logos as former Opticare.

claim: Medical Co. clinic at 157 New Brunswick Ave, Hopelawn, (908) 249-4145

problem: Avaap is a national Workday/Infor consultancy. Sunnyview Oval in Keasbey is an apartment-complex street, and a second Keasbey directory lists Avaap with a different phone (732-710-3425). No Avaap-owned page ties the firm to this address.

claim: Pequest Associates Inc., 'PO Box 215', Fords, (732) 738-8990 — land surveying

claim: Coverage: home-services and health categories in Fords
problem: None of the Fords roofing/GC/plumbing/HVAC/cleaning firms are listed, including several on bestprosintown's Fords page — a source this list itself cites (Elite Roofing & Restoration, Carter & Sons Roofing, Tri-County Construction Services, Fizer Plumbing & Heating, Central Air Mechanical, Truclean Cleaners). Chiropractor Lupo Chiropractic Center (786 King George Rd) is also missing. 19 of the 25 eligible businesses my ten searches surfaced are listed (76%, just above the bar); adding those four extra bestprosintown rows drops it to 66%, below the bar.

claim: Source citations on several rows (Xclusive Styles and Braids, Iron & Ivy Hair Studio, Design Hair Salon, New Image Dental, The Glam Palace)
problem: Source URLs such as 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/salon+near+Hopelawn+NJ' are search queries, not evidence for a specific business — they cannot be re-opened to confirm that entry's name, address or existence. These rows therefore do not meet the list's own 'needs triage' standard.
fix: Replace each search URL with the business's own site or a specific profile page, or move the row to a 'needs triage' file.
